## Dataset

- [Anandsah007/AI-Chandra-OCR](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Anandsah007/AI-Chandra-OCR) — text-recognition- [MohamedEmam2/gemma-ocr-lines](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedEmam2/gemma-ocr-lines) — handwriting-recognition, text-recognition: 
	
		
	
	
		Gemma OCR Lines (IAM + KHATT)
	

Line-level image/text pairs for training a CTC OCR recognizer. Every row is one
cropped text line with its transcript: handwriting from IAM (English) and
KHATT (Arabic), normalized into a single Latin+Arabic character vocabulary.
This is the frozen training corpus for the embedding-ocr CTC recognizer.
It exists so training never has to download the upstream datasets, re-filter
rows, or write tens of thousands of PNGs again. The corpus was packed… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedEmam2/gemma-ocr-lines.- [RADAXGRS/kyc-nuqta-ocr-fields](https://huggingface.co/datasets/RADAXGRS/kyc-nuqta-ocr-fields) — text-recognition: 
	
		
	
	
		KYC Nuqta OCR field pairs
	

One field crop of a real phone photo of a printed fictional Iraqi KYC document (national ID, tax card,
company licence) and the text an OCR reader must return for it. Made for fine-tuning
Nuqta-Arabic-OCR-0.8B, Reader 1 of the KYC
document agent (xgrs8/kyc_zain, private).
All documents are fictional. No real person's document is in this dataset.

	
		
	
	
		The target
	

text is the label: the printed truth when every character of the field is visible… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RADAXGRS/kyc-nuqta-ocr-fields.

## Paper

- [Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21706) — text-recognition: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. The data support studies of calf behaviour and welfare and the development and evaluation of automated behaviour recognition.
